job: Hold a place for content that is loading, with the same shape as the real thing.
purpose: Grey blocks that have the exact geometry of what they stand in for, so the real content swaps in without a line moving. Parts: text lines, titles by type role, avatar, button and tile. Presets for cards, grids, tables, stats, charts, lists, threads, forms, a hero and a whole page fill themselves from an empty element. Skeletons are aria-hidden; set aria-busy on the container.
useWhen: A region has a known layout and its data is on the way.
A route paints for the first time and the page needs rail, top bar and table in place.
Content swaps in place: wrap skeleton and content in data-fd-loading and call setLoading(el, false).

avoidWhen.when: A small control or one line of text.
The request failed; say what failed.
The page is empty on purpose.

states.name: loading
states.how: aria-busy="true" on the container; data-fd-loading="true" for a swap

states.name: ready
states.how: setLoading(el, false); the skeleton fades and the content rises 8px

states.name: stagger
states.how: --fd-i on a part staggers its shimmer

variants.useWhen: A chart skeleton drawn as bars instead of a line.
A button skeleton the width of an icon button.
An accent-tinted block, for the live part of a screen.
A title skeleton the height of display type.
A title skeleton at the h1 role.
A title skeleton at the h2 role.
A title skeleton at the h3 role.
A mono line such as a key or id.
A figure in a stat tile.

parts.role: Text lines of varied widths that end at 60%; data-lines sets how many.
A title bar at a type role.
A round block; data-size sets the diameter.
A card preset; on an fd-card the card supplies the frame.
Axes, gridlines and a faint series.
Rows of avatar, two lines and an action.
A whole first paint: rail, top bar, hero, toolbar and table.
The moving highlight, also used on status text.
